title: Actionist capability evidence state
description: Min-gated evidence state and lifecycle for one capability. Sprint 2 P15 proposal. Research only; UNEXECUTED; NOT_ADMITTED; zero instances exist.

lifecycle_state.description: unproven is the cold-start default and is NOT a negative judgement. Absence is not a negative signal.

families.description: Per-family evidence tier. The capability tier is the MINIMUM across these, never an average.

tier.description: min(families[*].tier). A single T1 family pins the capability at T1 regardless of eight T4s.

tier_rule.description: Never a weighted average. Averaging would let excellent adaptation cost compensate for unresolved rights.

weakest_family.description: The family setting the tier. When ranking is degenerate (AP15-7), THIS is the useful output: it names the missing evidence.

independent_observation_count.description: Observations with distinct cause_id. Ten observations of one correlated event count as one.

posterior.description: Estimator must be honest at n=10: wide intervals must read as 'unproven', not as a confident point estimate.

prior_transfer_validated.description: AP15-3 untested. Until E-P15-3 runs, priors must be weak enough that real observations dominate.

attribution_class.description: Ceiling on what may be concluded about this capability. Bound to P14 admission.

zero_tolerance_breaches.description: Any entry forces lifecycle_state = retired immediately. Never averaged against positive evidence.

retirement.description: Retirement requires a positive reason. Accumulated silence is NEVER a retirement trigger.

propagated_to_manifests.description: Revocation propagates to every composing assembly.

exploration_eligible.description: True only when every zero-tolerance gate passes and the workload is not regulated. Exploration is over quality, never safety.

unknown_reason.description: UNKNOWN stays UNKNOWN. It is not scored as zero and not treated as a negative signal.
